anomalies.observed: In the CAN BUS block, both GND1 and GND2 pins of each isolated transceiver are connected to the schematic's common GND net.
anomalies.expected: The controller-side and bus-side grounds should remain separate to preserve the galvanic isolation required for the CAN interfaces.

evidence.quote: U2: GND1, GND2; U29: GND1, GND2; each side is wired to GND power symbols (CAN BUS block, page 1/1).
two isolated CAN buses (CAN0, CAN1), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller through an isolated CAN transceiver

anomalies.impact: Tying the two grounds together bypasses the transceivers' isolation barrier, so the CAN interfaces will not provide the specified galvanic isolation and may pass ground differences or transients between the bus and motherboard.

parsed.summary: The schematic ties both ground pins on each CAN isolation transceiver to the same GND net. This defeats the galvanic isolation specified for both CAN interfaces.
